title: Smooth Lipschitz approximation with derivative bounds
statement: There is a sequence of positive real constants $(C_k)_{k\in\mathbb N}$. For every $c\ge 0$, every $c$-Lipschitz function $\psi\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$, and every $\eta>0$, there is a function $\psi_s\colon\mathbb R\to\mathbb R$ that is infinitely differentiable, satisfies $|\psi(t)-\psi_s(t)|\le c\eta$ for every $t\in\mathbb R$, and satisfies $|\psi_s^{(k)}(t)|\le C_k c/\eta^{k-1}$ for every integer $k\ge 1$ and every $t\in\mathbb R$.
hypotheses_covered: Each $C_k$ is positive for every natural number $k$
